name: Astaroth
source:
"I'm the strongest demon who is most fit to become king of the whole world ... Astaroth!"
A haughty and overbearing demon.
Because of Lucifer he fell into a dangerous situation so he makes a contract with the protagonist in order to use the ring and souls to help himself.
